newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia heads for normal autumn rain-bureau.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia heads for normal autumn rain-bureau.

text.p: Australia showed no significant bias toward either wetter or drier than normal conditions over most parts of the continent in the coming Southern Hemisphere autumn, the Bureau of Meteorology said.

The few exceptions were biases toward wetter than normal conditions in the southwest interior of Western Australia as well as in isolated districts in the eastern states, it said in its latest weather outlook.
The predictions were based on Southern Oscillation Index trends and recent rainfall patterns, a system which has low levels of skill or reliability at this time of year, the bureau said.
